versions.changelog:
Initial release: Zero-configuration Google Workspace toolkit (free edition).

- Provides instant access to Gmail, Calendar, and Drive core tools without Google Cloud Console setup.
- Supports Gmail (search, get, send, create draft), Calendar (list, events, create, free time), Drive (search, download).
- OAuth login enables usage—no manual API or credential configuration needed.
- Credentials auto-stored locally; token refresh and re-auth supported.
- Simple command-line and scripting integration for quick personal productivity.
